@funilrys since you wrote most of the code you might be interested, but don't feel obligated to review this code. 
Someone from the team will double-check it works :grin:

issue_context.title: Extract the dates ouf of the dumpv4
issue_context.body:
When importing a dump v4, we should extract the creation and last updated timestamp.
https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/blob/main/dump/src/reader/v4/mod.rs#L150-L169

The idea is to look at the whole task queue until you find the first task concerning your index (=last_updated_at), and you already have the task_uid of the task_creating it. Thus you then need to continue until you reach this task and extract its date as the creation_date.

review_comments: Yes, actually, this time, the index creation was done synchronously, which means the important timing was the task creation date and not the `processed` time!
